prompt: A Ferris wheel seat follows $h = 18\sin(x) + 22$ metres. What is the AMPLITUDE?
hint: The amplitude is the number multiplying the sine.

hints.text: The amplitude is the number multiplying the sine.
In $h = a\sin(x) + k$, the amplitude is $a$ and the midline is $k$.

explanation: The seat rises $18$ m above and falls $18$ m below the $22$ m midline, so the amplitude is $18$.

alternativeExplanations.title: From the highest and lowest points
steps: Highest is 22 + 18 = 40 m; lowest is 22 − 18 = 4 m.
Amplitude is HALF the gap: (40 − 4) ÷ 2 = 36 ÷ 2 = 18 m.

alternativeExplanations.title: Picture the wheel
steps: The centre of the wheel sits 22 m up — that is the midline.
The wheel carries you 18 m above and 18 m below that centre, so the amplitude IS the radius: 18 m.
